overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused and highly impactful academic cross-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, catering to a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), and academic opportunities, generating strong engagement particularly around research milestones and hiring announcements.

contentThemes.description: Posts highlighting methodologies, research papers, tool updates (CooRnet v2.0), and conference presentations around social media manipulation.
Announcements regarding research funding, postdoctoral hiring, and PhD research opportunities.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to capitalize on its high audience reach and professional interest in funding and hiring news.
Cross-promote tool releases like CooRnet across all platforms simultaneously to maximize direct audience reach and community adoption.
Leverage media, links, or visual assets (charts, graphics) in text posts to boost visual appeal and organic sharing.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate relative to follower count, driven by high repost/share counts on research papers and opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields strong niche discussions among academic peers, particularly regarding open-source tools like CooRnet and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest raw volume of interactions (likes and direct comments), serving as the main platform for career, grant, and institutional milestones.
